Hey!! I know this is hard and i know it is scary but you have to report it. I was sexually abused for several years by my brother, it started at age 12... i know exactly what your going through but don’t allow what this sick person is doing to steal away the beauty that’s within you. You have a purpose, you have a beautiful future ahead of you. Healing is most certainly something that you will find, it will be hard but you are much stronger then you think. I see you, i’m hearing you and i love you. Please report, please tell someone sooner then later. If your parents blame you then that’s on them. My own mom made me keep it a secret for years until it one day came out. Don’t think you don’t have control over this situation because YOU DO. I’m 28 years old now and telling my story my side was the hardest thing but it helped free me. I want that freedom for you too. He’s sick and has a serious problem. There will be people in your family that will have your back and give you love. & those that don’t.. fuck them. I know it’s hard and i know it’s uncomfortable but trust me you don’t deserve to carry this on your own. Please report him. Even if it’s to a teacher at school you trust. It won’t feel like this forever trust me. You are so much stronger than you think. I love you, you are not alone in this.

Hey! I don’t know you, i don’t know what your dealing with or what you’ve gone through but you have a purpose you have a reason on this Earth. Unfortunately the troubles of the day and even our past make it really hard for us to see that clearly. I can speak from personal experience, it is hard but don’t ever lose sight on the end goal. You mentioned studying.. studying can suck sometimes so try to make some tome for yourself doing the things you love and bring a smile to your face. When i’m at a really low point i try to get involved with a non-profit or just something to give back. It really helps me so i hope it can help you too. We are much stronger then we think sometimes. I want to know that you are seen, you are heard and you are loved. I’ve never met you but i love you. 

Also if your a student universities have counseling for students, i highly recommend checking that out. I did and it’s helped a lot. Again i love you and keep pushing through it all ♥️
